Name: Kitty Cats
Author: charlienosparkie
Description:
[center][size=3]Adds a bunch of kitty cats to Stardew Valley!

[b]Config:
[/b]AllowCatReplacements (true/false):
Default is true.
When true, your cat replacements (Like Elle's Cat Replacement) will work. Meaning the cats will use the custom skins you have. If you do not want the custom skins to be used for these cats, change the config to false. This will make it use the vanilla cat sprites.

[b]Compatible with:[/b]
Stardew Valley Expanded (Currently only Andy has a cat)

More mod-specific cats coming soon![/size]
